articles.title: Prince Harry warns AI chatbots can be more dangerous than social media for the young
articles.summary: NEW YORK (AP) — Prince Harry warned Wednesday at the Clinton Global Initiative that artificial intelligence chatbots designed to provide companionship are even more dangerous to young people than social media.

articles.title: Lionel Richie is taking a break from performing following a heart procedure
articles.summary: NEW YORK (AP) — Lionel Richie is taking a break from touring as he recovers from a heart procedure, a representative for the singer confirmed in a statement to The Associated Press on Wednesday.

articles.title: Fire breaks out near Hells Angels storefront in Leslieville
articles.summary: Toronto police and fire crews are investigating an early‑morning blaze at a Hells Angels storefront in Leslieville. Emergency crews were called to the area of Carlaw Avenue and Eastern Avenue at around 6:30 a.m. on Wednesday for reports of a house fire. Toronto Fire quickly extinguished the blaze, and no injuries were reported. Police say […]

articles.title: Raccoon rescued on Burlington highway ramp after drivers alert OPP
articles.summary: A quick‑thinking group of motorists helped OPP officers rescue a stranded raccoon last week after the animal wandered into live traffic on a busy Burlington highway ramp. OPP Burlington says drivers spotted the raccoon struggling in the left lane of the ramp from eastbound Hwy. 403 to Hwy. 407, prompting several calls to police. Officers […]

articles.title: 'Up to 2 hours in a car': Liberty Village residents share what they want the next mayor to fix
articles.summary: Traffic is hands down the biggest issue in Liberty Village — at least according to the residents we spoke with. Other top concerns? Street cleanliness and, well ... dog poop. This is the second installment of our new series, Toronto Speaks, where CBC’s Alejandrina Alvarez heads to neighbourhoods across the city to hear what matters most to people in their community.

articles.title: York police arrest 5, dismantle alleged criminal drug network operating through dark web
articles.summary: York police say they have arrested five people and dismantled a criminal network operating through the dark web following a months-long investigation.

articles.title: 2 people found dead in separate vehicle fires within hours of each other in Etobicoke and Scarborough
articles.summary: Emergency services responded to two fatal vehicle fires within hours of each other Monday night and early Tuesday.

articles.title: 18 injured in suspected arson at Mississauga apartment building
articles.summary: Residents in a Mississauga apartment building are shaken after a fire Monday morning, which police say may have been arson, sent at least 18 people to the hospital, including a firefighter and a police officer.

articles.title: 2 dead after shooting outside Scarborough seniors' medical centre: police
articles.summary: Two people are dead following a shooting outside a seniors’ medical centre in Scarborough Monday afternoon, Toronto police say.
